question: Which of the following is NOT a primary objective of the Special Economic Zone?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Promoting clean Technology**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **Special Economic Zone (SEZ)** primarily aims to** develop infrastructure, provide employment**,
 
• It promote exports by creating a favorable environment for businesses within a designated area, but** "promoting clean technology" is not typically** considered a core objective of an SEZ. 
 
• **SEZs are designed **to have well-developed infrastructure like roads, ports, and utilities to facilitate business operations. 
 
• The main goal of an** SEZ is to encourage companies to export good**s and services by offering tax benefits and streamlined procedures. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Special Economic Zones Act, 2005

 
 
• It is an Act that's provided for the institutions, development and management of the Special Economic Zones for the promotion of exports and for matters connected with that or incidental to that.
 
 
 
• Objectives of SEZs Act are:
 
 
• To create further economic activity.
 
• To encourage the export of goods and services.
 
• To provide employment.
 
• To boost domestic and foreign investments.
 
• To develop infrastructure facilities.
